depth_first_rationale: In the second turn the customer bundles dispute + card replacement ('all of it. I want my money back and a new card') rather than focusing on one issue at a time, though subsequent turns are appropriately sequential.
uncertainty_rationale: Given the certain_fraud scenario, the customer's assertive 'yes obviously' and 'never heard of them before this' are appropriately confident without sounding robotic or over-committed.
